rationale: Although the stock bounced off the $80.35 level immediately after entry and reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($80.91), the rally has stalled right at session VWAP ($81.07). The last two 1-minute candles show upper wicks rejecting the $81.16–$81.17 zone with a bearish close on the most recent bar, while volume on the bounce remained subdued (~50k per minute). With the hard invalidation at $81.25 still intact just above this resistance cluster, the risk-to-reward favors holding to see if the VWAP rejection resumes the primary downtrend.
